svg.title: TDD implementation roadmap for gym-api Supabase migration
svg.desc: Four phases shown as red-then-green TDD cycles: packages and setup, data repositories, auth, and DI wiring

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What NuGet packages do I need to add for Supabase EF Core and JWT?')
sendPrompt('Show me the GymApiDbContext with OnModelCreating for TrainingSession and ExerciseEntry')
g.text: OnModelCreating · private field mapping · dotnet ef migrations add Init

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Write a failing integration test for SupabaseTrainingSessionRepository.SaveAsync and GetByIdAsync')
sendPrompt('Write a failing integration test for SupabaseUserRepository.SaveAsync GetByIdAsync and GetByEmailAsync')
sendPrompt('Show me SupabaseTrainingSessionRepository implementing ITrainingSessionRepository with EF Core DbContext')
sendPrompt('Show me SupabaseUserRepository implementing IUserRepository with EF Core DbContext')

g.text: Domain unchanged · InMemory repos kept for unit tests and local dev

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Write a failing test for JwtUserContext that reads UserId from a JWT sub claim via IHttpContextAccessor')
sendPrompt('Write a failing integration test for a protected endpoint that requires a valid Supabase JWT')
sendPrompt('Show me JwtUserContext implementing IUserContext by reading the sub claim from IHttpContextAccessor')
sendPrompt('Show me AddAuthentication and AddJwtBearer configuration for Supabase in Program.cs')
sendPrompt('Write a failing smoke test that verifies the full DI container resolves ITrainingSessionRepository and IUserContext correctly with Supabase config')
sendPrompt('Show me the updated Program.cs with feature-flag DI swap between InMemory and Supabase repos, appsettings config, and Azure Key Vault wiring')
g.text: feature-flag swap InMemory ↔ Supabase · secrets via Azure.Identity
UserController: remove mock login · add [Authorize] · client auth goes direct to Supabase
